name: ImageTrail-TS-TW
title: Image Cursor Trail
blurb: Images follow your cursor in a smooth, staggered trail.
description: A cursor-following component that displays images from an array in a staggered trail effect. Uses GSAP animations with easing to create smooth motion along the pointer path.
use_when: You want an interactive visual element that rewards cursor movement with animated imagery or a playful gallery.
avoid_when: Touch-only devices or when consistent 60fps performance isn't guaranteed.
a11y: Purely visual cursor tracking; no keyboard alternative or prefers-reduced-motion guard.
